pages.text: Botania is the primary Tier 1 magic mod. Mana generation, magical flowers, and the Mana Pool.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Your first mana system. Manasteel is the T1 magic material ceiling. Botania's Orechid is datapack-restricted so it cannot tier-skip: Diamond, Osmium, and Ancient Debris are disabled, so it yields only lower-tier ores.$(br2)$(bold)Key IridescentCraft interactions:$() Botania mana tools are affected by Faefolk's Nature Magic racial (+15% effectiveness). The Lexica Botania is the in-mod documentation — read it.

$(bold)Tier gating:$() Terrasteel and Elementium are T3 materials in this pack — crafting them requires T3 to be unlocked. Manasteel and Mana Pearl are the T1–T2 ceiling.$(br2)$(bold)Gaia Guardian:$() Summoned Botania capstone, T4 content. Drops Magiblade unique weapon (20%) and Gaia Spirit Fragments. Scales progressively.
Craft the $(bold)Lexica Botania$() for the full in-mod reference — every flower, every mana structure, every ritual. Essential reading for any Botania build.
